title: Rooftop picnic
description: Blanket, snacks from the corner shop, and whatever the sky is doing.

title: Cooking class night
description: Learn to make something neither of us has cooked before.

title: Blanket fort and old films
description: Every cushion in the house. No phones allowed inside the fort.

title: Sunrise walk and breakfast after
description: Painfully early, worth it, coffee immediately afterwards.

title: The nicest dinner we can justify
description: Dress up properly. Order the thing we'd normally talk ourselves out of.

title: Get deliberately lost
description: Pick a direction, keep going, see where we end up for lunch.

title: Terrible-movie marathon
description: The worse the reviews, the better. Snacks are mandatory.

title: Museum, then argue about the art
description: Both pick a favourite piece and defend it to the death.

title: Spa day at home
description: Face masks, terrible music, absolutely no plans.

title: Mini road trip
description: Somewhere at least two hours away. One night, one bag each.

title: Dance in the kitchen
description: One playlist, no audience, no dignity.

title: Stargazing somewhere dark
description: Drive out past the lights, take a thermos, stay too long.

title: Bookshop crawl
description: Each of us picks a book for the other. No vetoes.

title: Cocktails somewhere we can't pronounce
description: Order the strangest thing on the menu each.

title: Long lunch, no schedule
description: Sit somewhere with good light and stay until they need the table.
